refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoParseInfix function parses the Siliko infix language from a SilikoLexer which reads a series of characters from input. The SilikoParseInfix then generates a syntax tree of SilikoNode objects representing the parsed input. The parser will take ownership of input, and call SilikoInputDestroy on it when finished.

refsection.title: Return Value
refsection.para: SilikoParseInfix returns a pointer to the root node of the syntax tree generated from parsing the input from the input source or NULL if it is unable to allocate memory.
